summary: Tested session filtering features on CoachMyDevelopment page. Found 2 bugs related to default timeframe and Session Parts filter visibility. Zero data display bug appears to be FIXED.

ui_bugs.issue: Default timeframe not setting to '3 months' for users with limited data retention (free tier)
ui_bugs.root_cause: Logic in SessionFilters.jsx only checks for tier === 'individual', but API returns tier: 'free' for Individual accounts
ui_bugs.fix_suggestion: Change line 78 from 'if (tier === 'individual' && filters.timeframe === 'all')' to 'if ((tier === 'individual' || tier === 'free') && filters.timeframe === 'all')'

ui_bugs.issue: Session Parts filter not showing in filters section
ui_bugs.root_cause: Session Parts filter only renders if sessionParts.length > 0. All sessions in database have empty session_parts arrays, so availableSessionParts derived from sessions is empty
ui_bugs.fix_suggestion: This is a DATA ISSUE, not a CODE BUG. Sessions need to be created with session_parts assigned. The filter will appear when sessions have parts.

zero_data_bug.details: When filtering by Sunday (no sessions), metrics correctly show 0 Sessions Observed, 0% Avg Ball Rolling, 0 Avg Interventions. Shows appropriate message 'Complete some observation sessions to see your intervention patterns'

timeframe_filter.details: Timeframe filter is present and functional. However, default value shows 'Upgrade for All Time' instead of 'Last 3 Months' for Individual/free tier users

session_type_filter.details: All Sessions, Training Only, Game Only options present and working

days_of_week_filter.details: All 7 days selectable, visual highlighting works, shows 'Showing sessions on: [selected days]' message

session_parts_filter.details: Filter not rendered because no sessions have session_parts data. The code correctly conditionally renders this filter only when parts exist.

action_items: FIX: Update SessionFilters.jsx line 78 to also check for tier === 'free' when setting default timeframe to '3months'
VERIFY: Confirm that the API correctly returns tier as 'individual' for Individual subscription tier accounts (currently returns 'free')
NOTE: Session Parts filter will appear automatically when sessions are created with session_parts data - no code fix needed for this
critical_code_review_comments: SessionFilters.jsx line 78: The tier check only handles 'individual' but the API returns 'free' for users with 3-month data retention limit
The tier naming inconsistency between frontend expectations ('individual') and backend returns ('free') causes the default timeframe logic to fail

success_rate.frontend: 60% (Zero data bug fixed, but default timeframe bug and session parts visibility issues remain)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Zero data bug is fixed. Default timeframe bug is in SessionFilters.jsx line 78 - needs to check for 'free' tier as well as 'individual'. Session Parts filter won't show until sessions have session_parts data populated.

default_timeframe_bug.root_cause: Tier mismatch between frontend expectation and backend response
reproduction_steps: 4. Observe Time Period shows 'Upgrade for All Time' instead of 'Last 3 Months'
default_timeframe_bug.technical_details: SessionFilters.jsx useEffect at line 72-83 checks if (tier === 'individual') but /api/coach/analytics returns {tier: 'free'} for this user. The condition fails and default isn't set.
default_timeframe_bug.mitigation: Update the condition to: if ((tier === 'individual' || tier === 'free') && filters.timeframe === 'all')

reproduction_steps: 2. Expand Filters on My Development page
3. Session Parts filter is not visible
session_parts_filter_missing.technical_details: The filter only renders when sessionParts.length > 0 (line 414 in SessionFilters.jsx). All 15 sessions have empty session_parts arrays.
session_parts_filter_missing.mitigation: This is expected behavior - filter only shows when there's data to filter by. Need to create sessions with session_parts assigned.
